summary: YPF filed a Form 6-K reporting the completion of an open-market share repurchase program. Between 8 and 12 June 2026, the company acquired 461,311 Class D ordinary shares on the ByMA exchange at an average price of Ps. 83,321.2504 per share, for a total of Ps. 38,437,009,350. The purchases complied with a daily limit of 25% of average daily trading volume over the prior 90 business days. The board-approved buyback has now been fully executed. This is an issuer tender in the U.S. sense of an issuer purchasing its own shares. No financial advisor or specific premium was cited. Watch for future share cancellation and the impact on EPS.
